title: Atopic Dermatitis-Like Skin Disease in Pediatric Heart Transplant Patients
brief_summary: The skin disease found in pediatric heart transplant patients represents an atopic dermatitis-like rash that is refractory to systemic immunomodulation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients must have had a heart transplant.
* Patients must be less than 16 years of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have not had a heart transplant.
* Patients who are greater than 16 years of age.
